sentences.text: Colymbiculus is an extinct genus of loon found in Novopskov, Ukraine.
This animal belongs to the family Gaviidae, the group containing modern loons.
The extinct genus Colymbiculus was described by Mayr and Zvonok in 2011.
The type species of the genus Colymbiculus is Colymbiculus udovichenkoi.
Only one fossil occurrence of Colymbiculus has been recorded.
The species lived between 48.07 and 41.03 million years ago during the Lutetian stage.
